name: toolkit
description: Optional utilities for the workshop: html-artifact (reports, plans, architecture explanations, and interactive product targets), ui-demo-video (Playwright walkthroughs with verification frames), get-pr-comments (triages a PR's feedback into a prioritized action list, read-only), adopt-global-rules (installs the workshop's shipped global CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, rules, and Claude output styles onto a machine, additively), me-human (dogfood a system from a human user's perspective), test-audit (gates new tests and audits or prunes low-value ones), dependency-audit (audits dependencies for bumps, caveats, conflicts, advisories and removal candidates, then applies the groups you pick), grill-me (a relentless interview that sharpens a plan, run by grilling), and improve-codebase-architecture (finds deepening refactors, with codebase-design and domain-modeling). Install alongside workbench when you want them; skip to keep sessions lean.
